verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own manual has a section on Git submodules, so the product appears to handle them. The only evidence is a one-line generic definition of what submodules are, with no description of how the app clones, updates or manages them. missing for 10: documented submodule clone/init workflow, documented submodule update/sync to tracked commits, documented management actions (add/remove/change URL or branch), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can clone, update, and manage Git submodules within a repository

citations.quote: Git submodules allow you to include other Git repositories within your repository, keeping their histories separate.
